_wiki.question: How do I breed cows?
_wiki.answer: Feed wheat to two adult cows that are close together. They can produce a calf.

_wiki.question: How do I breed sheep?
_wiki.answer: Feed wheat to two adult sheep. You can also dye sheep and shear their wool.

_wiki.question: How do I breed chickens?
_wiki.answer: Feed seeds to two adult chickens. They can produce a chick.

_wiki.question: How do I breed wolves?
_wiki.answer: Tame two wolves, then feed each appropriate meat while both are at full health to breed them.

_wiki.question: How do I breed cats?
_wiki.answer: Tame two cats and feed each raw cod or raw salmon to breed them.

_wiki.question: How do I breed axolotls?
_wiki.answer: Feed each of two adult axolotls a bucket of tropical fish. Ordinary tropical fish items will not work.

_wiki.question: How rare is a blue axolotl?
_wiki.answer: When breeding axolotls, a blue baby is very rare unless one parent is already blue. Check current Bedrock rates before giving exact odds.

_wiki.question: Can parrots be bred?
_wiki.answer: No. Parrots can be tamed with seeds, but they cannot be bred in normal Minecraft gameplay.

_wiki.question: How do I stop hostile mobs spawning near my base?
_wiki.answer: Light up dark areas and use suitable spawn-proof surfaces, such as carpets or bottom slabs. Some mobs have special spawning rules.

_wiki.question: Can monsters spawn on bottom slabs?
_wiki.answer: Most ordinary ground-spawning hostile mobs cannot spawn on bottom slabs; other special spawn rules may apply.

_wiki.question: Can hostile mobs spawn on carpet?
_wiki.answer: Ordinary ground-spawning hostile mobs generally cannot spawn on carpet.

_wiki.question: Which blocks fall when unsupported?
_wiki.answer: Sand, gravel, concrete powder, and anvils are examples of gravity-affected blocks. Many other blocks remain floating.

_wiki.question: Do Java BUD switches work in Bedrock?
_wiki.answer: Many Java-style block update detector circuits do not work in Bedrock. Use Bedrock-tested observer-based designs instead.

_wiki.question: Can I make a flying machine in Bedrock?
_wiki.answer: Yes, but piston and observer designs must be built for Bedrock; Java Edition layouts may behave differently.

_wiki.question: How do I use a shield in Bedrock?
_wiki.answer: Equip a shield in the offhand and crouch to raise it. It blocks many direct attacks, but not every kind of damage.

_wiki.question: Can I build a Java-style global mob switch in Bedrock?
_wiki.answer: Not in the same way. Bedrock spawning uses local limits; Java global mob-switch tutorials should not be copied directly.
